video_prompt: One continuous horizontal full-frame shot from the first frame to the last, filmed on a phone front camera on a tripod. The woman — a woman about 31 years old with fair skin, light freckles and copper-red wavy hair tied back in a loose low bun with a few strands framing her face, small gold stud earrings, wearing a black fitted turtleneck sweater — sits alone in a tidy home office with a white wall and floating wooden shelves behind her holding ceramic vases, small potted succulents and a woven basket, a black metal desk lamp, soft neutral daylight, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same position in the frame, same distance from the camera. The camera stays still and the room around her stays still and calm. She talks straight into the camera, sincere and a little worried, like confiding in a friend, with small natural head movements and small nods; her shoulders stay relaxed, her face stays centered in the frame, and between sentences her head settles back into the same upright, centered, front-facing resting pose she has in the first frame.
